senses.gloss:
āmbhasī-dhāraṇā
(‘fixing the मिन्द् on the water principle’)
------------------------------------------
It is one of the five dhāraṇās techni-cally known as ‘pañcadhāraṇās’ in the works on हठयोग. Such dhāraṇās help in the conquest of the मिन्द्. When guided properly, this can lead to the realization of the Self. Incidentally, certain super-normal powers are also attained in the process.
Āmbhasī-dhāraṇa is धारणा or fixing the मिन्द् on the principle of ambhas or water. The water principle is white like the kunda flower or conch or मोओन्. It is circular in form with विष्णु as the presiding deity and ‘va’ as the बीज (seed-letter). Fixing the मिन्द् along with the प्राण (through कुम्भक प्राणायाम) for five ghaṭikās (one ghaṭikā = 24 minutes) will help the योगि to destroy all sorrows. The योगि who has perfected this will not die even in deepest water.
